question: In which part of India is the festival 'Moatsu' celebrated?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Nagaland**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The festival of **Moatsu** is celebrated by the **Ao tribe** of Nagaland.
 
• It is an important festival that marks the end of the sowing season and the beginning of a period of rest and relaxation.
 
• Moatsu is celebrated in the first week of May, usually from **May 1st to May 3rd**.
 
• During the festival, the Ao people engage in various activities including **singing, dancing, and feasting**.
 
• The festival also includes rituals to invoke blessings for a bountiful harvest and protection from natural calamities.
 
• Traditional attire and cultural performances are a significant part of the celebration, showcasing the rich heritage of the Ao tribe.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Maharashtra**__

 __
 
• Maharashtra is known for its diverse festivals like **Ganesh Chaturthi, Gudi Padwa, and Diwali**.
 
• Ganesh Chaturthi is one of the most important festivals celebrated with great fervor and enthusiasm across the state.
 
 
 
• **Rajasthan**__
 __
 
• Rajasthan is famous for its vibrant festivals such as **Pushkar Camel Fair, Teej, and Gangaur**.
 
• The Pushkar Camel Fair is a unique event that attracts tourists from all over the world.
 
 
 
• **Goa**__
 
 
• Goa is renowned for its **Carnival, Christmas, and New Year celebrations**.
 
• The Goa Carnival is a major attraction, featuring parades, music, and dance.
